notices: Removed WANOPT, NETSCAN, FEXP features from USB-A
FortiGate-92D High Availability in Interface Mode
Use of dedicated management interfaces (mgmt1 and mgmt2)

observations.description: Encounter several scanunit daemon crash in firewall.
Add the limit to the total entries of ssl-exempt in CLI and GUI.
Loopback interface: Debug Flow and logs do not show the usage of FW policy ID.
Policy does not work as intended when there are two IPv6 VIPs which have the same mappedip but different extip.
Some policy settings are not installed in complex sessions.
FortiOS XSS issue via srcintf during firewall policy creation.
Stored XSS vulnerability in the firewall policy global-label parameter.
diag sys vdom-property does not work on FG-1000D.
FG-1500D running 5.2.3 was unresponsive with error of unregister_netdevice.
UDP jumbo frames arriving fragmented on a FG-3600C are blocked when acceleration is enabled.
FortiOS Event Log False Alarms: msg = "PS Status not detected".
CSRF token is disclosed in several URLs.
FG-40C loses traffic shaper settings after the firewall policy was edited in GUI.
VDOM list page does not load.
Message ha_fib_rtnl_hdl: msg truncated, increase buf size showing up on console.
Pingserver priority not reset to 0 when pingserver-slave-force-reset is enabled and pingserver-flip-timeout has expired.
After IPS is enabled on LB-VIP policy, you get a message: ipsapp session open failed: all providers busy.
There are EXT2 and EXT3 errors from Console.
Log rate is only 30K without any log lost on FG-3700D.
The username is truncated in Webfilter and DLP logs.
High CPU usage by SSL VPN.
SSL VPN should support Windows 10 OS check.
Citrix with XenApp 7.x not working via SSL VPN Web Portal.
VLAN interface Rx bytes statistics higher than underlying aggregate interface.
False positive sensor alarms in event log.
Software switch interface member lost in non-root VDOM after reboot if root VDOM is TP mode.
IPv6 neighbor cache exhaustion denial of service may use up CPU resources.
DHCP server doesn’t send DHCPNAK when client’s request is invalid.
Configuring MTU on interface of FG-80D has no effect on actual MTU.
FortiManager backup ADOM does not Auto-Sync configuration.
FortiOS local admin password hashes could be obtained.
After FortiGate finished sync up with FortiAuthenticator, the using user group policy lost some configuration in FortiGate.
When FortiGate received the update user information from FortiAuthenticator, it takes a lot of time.
High memory usage in slab size-16384.
CPU spikes abnormally several times a day.
DHCP server hangs and must be restarted to start servicing clients.
SLBC - FIB sync may fail if there is a large routing table update.
Fix memory leak in virtual server when configuration changes.
dhcpd crash with signal 11 and FortiGate DHCP server service stop.
Spontaneous WAD high CPU across multiple cores.
FortiGate processing LACP packets with non LACP MAC destination and renegotiation causes existing active LACP link to flap.
3G redundant interface loses configuration settings after reboot.
Checksum control is not working when upgrading firmware from Fortigate GUI.
Downgrading firmware from 5.4.4 to 5.2.4 via GUI stops SSH, GUI, and console access to the appliance.
Fixed iked crash.
WAD consumes high memory usage with WANOPT and Webcache.
Webfilter override present certificate re-signed using SHA-1.
WAD memory leak suspected.
WAD crashes with a signal 11 (Segmentation fault) in wad_port_fwd_ peer_shutdown and __wad_http_session_task_end.
WAD crash when flush ftp over http traffic.
Spamfilter does not leave Anti-Spam log for the exempted traffic by bwl matching.
Traffic may not be able to go through the NPU VDOM link with traffic shaper enabled on FG-3810D TP mode.
FG-3815D does not support 1GE SFP transceivers.
The UTM log may incorrectly report a file that has been sent to FortiSandbox. FortiView > FortiSandbox may still show files are submitted even after the daily upload quota has been reached.
Local-category status display may not change after running unset category-over-ride in the CLI.
Adding an override application signature may cause all category settings to be lost.
All sessions: filter application, threat, and threat type may not work as expected.
When creating an id_based policy with SSL enabled, and the set gui-multipleutm disable is applied, an Entry not found error message may appear.
Explicit policy may be automatically reset to log security events.
When navigating FortiView > Application some security action filters may not work.
Users may not be able to create new address objects from the Firewall Policy.
LDAP browser in LDAP-group-GUI may not respect group filter from LDAP server.
On NP4 platforms, TCP traffic may not be able to be offloaded in the decryption direction.
Adding more than eight members to LACP get np6_lacp_add_slave may result in an error.
Medium type may be shown incorrectly on shared ports.
SIP calls may be denied when using a combination of SIP ALG, IPS, and AppCtrl.
If the requested URL has port number, the URL filter may not block properly.
YouTube header injection (replacement for YouTube for Schools) was deleted.
Webfilter static URL filter blocks additional domains with similar names.
If the client is connecting to an SSID with WPA-Enterprise and User-group, it may not be able to pass the traffic policy.
SSID may stop broadcasting.
Possible root cause of SSL VPN fail on error:0B080074:…X509_check_private_ key:key values mismatch…ApacheSSLSetCertStuff failed.
